boundedPointerReads.source: First pointer of each of the 32 fixed schema records
boundedPointerReads.require: Each pointer must resolve entirely within a file-backed ELF load; field name must be NUL-terminated ASCII within 80 bytes

schemaAssertions: The first fixed record must name m_flMaxSpeed and declare member offset 0x748, matching the retained server schema log.
Exactly one record in the fixed window must name m_nZoomLevels and declare member offset 0x7f4.
Record layout is a name pointer at +0 and uint32 member offset at +16, matching previously bound schema records.
limits: No native execution, code scan, arbitrary target following or bridge use in this static step.
Whole binary SHA is streamed before fixed reads.
If the current AWP slot differs from the retained gun target, stop; do not automatically read its target.
If the named field is absent or any fixed assertion fails, retain the failure and stop rather than widen.
This fixed schema window binds named field records; a separate owner descriptor is not inferred from proximity.
